name: Example LCA Quantities Export
description: Generates material quantity output for a life cycle assessment (LCA), based on the ERC Mainbuilding IFC. Produces two CSV files in the export folder: material quantities and a per-element overview. IFC path should be updated to match your local repository location.
notes: Based on examples/e1_export_quantities_for_lca.py. No decisions are expected for this IFC file with the LCA backend. After execution, check the export folder for Material_quantities_ERC_Mainbuilding_Arch.csv (mass of each material used) and Quantities_overview_ERC_Mainbuilding_Arch.csv (per-element breakdown with materials).
